facts.name: --dry-run is given
facts.says: The flag. The page: 'Validate without merging, tagging, or pushing'.

facts.name: release.branch is set
facts.says: The page: 'release.branch set selects merge flow; empty selects trunk flow.' The settings list also says 'An absent key means its default' and gives the default as 'the branch pk init ran on'. The page does not say which flow an absent key selects.

facts.name: a preRelease hook is set
facts.says: release.hooks.preRelease: 'a shell command; default none'.

facts.name: a prePush hook is set
facts.says: release.hooks.prePush: 'a shell command; default none'.

facts.name: HEAD carries a Release-Tag trailer
facts.says: The last commit of the checked-out branch has a Release-Tag trailer. The page says pk changelog stages it. This definition holds no changelog run, so nothing here makes it.

facts.name: the preRelease hook commits
facts.says: The page: 'A preRelease hook that commits produces a commit the tag then covers.'

facts.name: .pk.json has an unknown key or a value outside the settings
facts.says: The page: 'An unknown key or a value outside these fails the whole file when it loads, with a message naming the key: pk commands exit 2'.

facts.name: no branch is checked out
facts.says: Pre-flight: 'a branch checked out'.

facts.name: the checked-out branch is not on origin
facts.says: Pre-flight: 'a branch checked out, on origin'.

facts.name: the checked-out branch is behind origin
facts.says: Pre-flight: 'a branch checked out, on origin and not behind it'.

facts.name: the release branch does not resolve
facts.says: Pre-flight: 'release branch resolvable'.

facts.name: the last version tag is not in the checked-out branch's history
facts.says: Pre-flight: 'the last version tag in the working branch's history'.

facts.name: the checked-out branch is not the default branch
facts.says: Trunk flow: 'a release tags and pushes the default branch, and refuses to run anywhere else'. The page does not say what makes a branch the default branch.

facts.name: the preRelease hook fails
facts.says: The hook's command exits non-zero. The page does not mention it.

facts.name: the prePush hook fails
facts.says: The hook's command exits non-zero. The page does not mention it.

facts.name: pre-flight fetches origin's tags
facts.says: The page says 'Pre-flight fetches from origin to make these checks.' It does not say what is fetched: the checked-out branch, the release branch, the tags, or all of them. This definition fetches the checked-out branch, because one check is 'on origin and not behind it', and leaves the tags open. A fetch of the release branch is not modelled.

facts.name: the preRelease hook runs before the merge
facts.says: The page says preRelease 'runs before the tag exists'. It does not say whether that is before or after the release branch is fast-forwarded, so it does not say which branch a hook's commit lands on in merge flow, or whether a failed hook leaves a merge behind. It also does not say whether the hook runs before or after pre-flight. This definition puts it after.

facts.name: a rehearsed preRelease hook runs its command
facts.says: The page says preRelease 'is rehearsed by --dry-run'. It does not say whether a rehearsal runs the hook's command, so it does not say whether a hook that commits makes its commit in a dry run.

facts.name: a failing preRelease hook stops the release
facts.says: The page does not say what release does when the preRelease hook's command exits non-zero.

facts.name: a dry run runs the prePush hook
facts.says: The page says --dry-run rehearses preRelease. It says prePush 'runs with the tag ref in existence', and a dry run makes no tag. It does not say whether a dry run runs or rehearses prePush.

facts.name: a failing prePush hook stops the release
facts.says: The page says 'A failure after tagging rolls back'. It does not say whether a prePush hook whose command exits non-zero is such a failure.

facts.name: a failed switch back still pushes the working branch
facts.says: The page says 'a failure to switch back or to push the working branch is reported as a warning'. It does not say whether the working branch is still pushed after the switch back fails.

release.name: release
release.says: Completes what pk changelog staged: reads the Release-Tag trailer on HEAD, runs pre-flight checks, creates the tag, and pushes atomically to origin.

seq.says: release.branch set selects merge flow; empty selects trunk flow.

load the settings.says: The release section of .pk.json. An unknown key or a value outside these fails the whole file when it loads.

handles.says: pk commands exit 2, with a message naming the key.

read the trailer.says: Reads the Release-Tag trailer on HEAD.

handles.says: With no Release-Tag trailer on HEAD it refuses, and says to run pk changelog first.

pre-flight.name: pre-flight
pre-flight.says: Pre-flight fetches from origin to make these checks.

check.says: No tag of the release's name yet; clean tree; a branch checked out, on origin and not behind it; release branch resolvable and not diverged from the working branch; the last version tag in the working branch's history. The page lists the checks. It does not say in words that a failed check refuses the release, nor in what order they are made.
